rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Type Conversion or Cast
rules.description: Assigning to a property of a primitive value has no effect and may trigger a runtime error.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.

rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
rules.description: Server-side URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
rules.description: Conditions that the user controls are not suited for making security-related decisions.

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: If an object literal has two properties with the same name, the second property overwrites the first one, which makes the code hard to understand and error-prone.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
rules.description: If an HTML element has two attributes with the same name but different values, its behavior may be browser-dependent.

rules.cwe_name: Off-by-one Error
rules.description: An array index is compared to be less than or equal to the 'length' property, and then used in an indexing operation that could be out of bounds.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Replacing a substring with itself has no effect and may indicate a mistake.

rules.cwe_name: Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type ('Type Confusion')
rules.description: Sanitizing an HTTP request parameter may be ineffective if the user controls its type.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Enabling `nodeIntegration` or `nodeIntegrationInWorker` can expose the application to remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Type Conversion or Cast
rules.description: Assigning to a property of a primitive value has no effect and may trigger a runtime error.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Enabling `nodeIntegration` or `nodeIntegrationInWorker` can expose the application to remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Web Functionality from an Untrusted Source
rules.description: Including functionality from an untrusted source may allow an attacker to control the functionality and execute arbitrary code.

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: If an object literal has two properties with the same name, the second property overwrites the first one, which makes the code hard to understand and error-prone.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
rules.description: Comparing different kinds of HTTP request data may be a symptom of an insufficient security check.

rules.cwe_name: Dead Code
rules.description: An expression that has no effect and is used in a void context is most likely redundant and may indicate a bug.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Authorization
rules.description: An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.

rules.cwe_name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
rules.description: Deserializing user-controlled data may allow attackers to execute arbitrary code.
